result.instructions: Tools for Stuart, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How much would a courier from 32 Coombe Lane, London SW20 0LA to 23 Ethelbert Rd, London SW20 8QD cost for a medium package?"; "Show my deliveries that are still in progress and where each courier is."; "Is 10 Rue de Rivoli, Paris inside Stuart's delivery area?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Stuart data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run stuart_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run stuart_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run stuart_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. stuart_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: stuart_list_jobs
tools.title: List delivery jobs
tools.description: List the delivery jobs of the last 90 days, newest pickup first, with status, deliveries (tracking URLs, courier proof), driver and pricing. Filter by status, active or your client_reference. Paginated: when a page returns per_page rows, ask for the next page. Stuart: GET /v2/jobs.

status.description: Job status filter, e.g. in_progress, finished, canceled.

active.description: true = only jobs still in progress.

tools.name: stuart_get_job
tools.title: Get a delivery job
tools.description: One job in full: status, each delivery with tracking URL, pickup/dropoff addresses and contacts, ETA, cancellation, proof of delivery, driver, distance and pricing. Stuart: GET /v2/jobs/{jobId}.

tools.name: stuart_estimate_price
tools.title: Get a delivery price quote
tools.description: Price of a job before you create it: amount excluding and including tax, and currency. Nothing is booked. Needs pickup address, dropoff address and package type. Stuart: POST /v2/jobs/pricing.

address.description: Street address only. Floor, door and building details go in comment.

comment.description: Note for the courier (floor, door code location, ...).

contact.description: Either firstname + lastname, or company, is required by Stuart.

phone.description: E.164, e.g. +442079476330. Required if the address is not precise.

coordinates.description: Optional coordinates (up to 6 decimals). An address string is still required.

tools.name: stuart_validate_address
tools.title: Validate a pickup or dropoff address
tools.description: Check that an address can be geocoded and lies inside a Stuart zone, as a pickup (picking) or a dropoff (delivering). A phone number is needed when the address is approximate. Stuart: POST /v2/addresses/validate.

type.description: picking = pickup address, delivering = dropoff address.

phone.description: Contact phone (E.164); required when the address is not precise.

coordinates.description: Optional coordinates (up to 6 decimals). An address string is still required.

annotations.title: Validate a pickup or dropoff address

tools.name: stuart_get_zone_coverage
tools.title: Get a zone's coverage area
tools.description: GeoJSON of the picking or delivery area of an open Stuart zone (for example paris, london). Stuart: GET /v2/areas/{zone}.

tools.name: stuart_get_zone_schedule_slots
tools.title: Get a zone's scheduling slots
tools.description: Available time slots (start and end, 15-minute steps) in a zone for a date, from the time of the request onward. Use a future date. Stuart: GET /v2/jobs/schedules/{zone}/{type}/{date}.

tools.name: stuart_get_courier_phone
tools.title: Get the courier's anonymous phone number
tools.description: Anonymised phone number of the courier assigned to a delivery. Only works once a courier is assigned; expires when the delivery ends. Stuart: GET /v2/deliveries/{deliveryId}/phone_number.

delivery_id.description: Stuart delivery id (the id inside a job's deliveries, not the job id).

annotations.title: Get the courier's anonymous phone number

tools.name: stuart_create_job
tools.title: Create a delivery job (dispatches a courier)
tools.description: BOOKS A REAL, CHARGED DELIVERY: creates a job with one pickup and 1-8 dropoffs and starts looking for a courier right away (unless pickup_at schedules it: up to 4 days ahead, 30 for corporate accounts). Get a quote with stuart_estimate_price and check with stuart_validate_job first, and confirm with the user. Use the sandbox environment for tests. Stuart: POST /v2/jobs.

tools.name: stuart_update_job
tools.title: Update delivery details
tools.description: Change allowed details of a delivery in a job: client_reference, package_description, and the pickup/dropoff comment and contact (what is editable depends on the delivery status: once delivered only client_reference). Stuart: PATCH /v2/jobs/{jobId}.

tools.name: stuart_cancel_job
tools.title: Cancel a delivery job
tools.description: Cancels a whole job and all its deliveries. Stuart may charge a cancellation fee once a courier is on the way; confirm with the user first. Give a reason key for reporting. Stuart: POST /v2/jobs/{jobId}/cancel.

tools.name: stuart_cancel_delivery
tools.title: Cancel one delivery
tools.description: Cancels a single delivery (one dropoff) of a multi-drop job. A cancellation fee may apply; confirm with the user first. Stuart: POST /v2/deliveries/{deliveryId}/cancel.

tools.name: stuart_mark_order_ready
tools.title: Signal that an order is ready for pickup
tools.description: Tell Stuart the order is packed and ready for the courier to collect. Pass exactly one of job_id (all orders of the job) or delivery_id (one order). Send it only when the order is really ready. Stuart: POST /v2/jobs/{jobId}/order_ready or /v2/deliveries/{deliveryId}/order_ready.

job_id.description: Stuart job id (all orders under the job).

order_ready_at.description: ISO 8601 time it became ready; default = now (server time).

annotations.title: Signal that an order is ready for pickup
